cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY'
p='src/image.cpp'
s=open(p).read()
import re
# Insert a FAIL() macro that reports a reason, replacing bare "return false;" inside
# the Validator implementation only, using a line-safe approach on multi-line statements.
start=s.index('bool Validator::run(')
end=s.index('bool Validator::read_child(')
body=s[start:end]
cnt=[0]
res=[]
for l in body.split('\n'):
    if 'return false;' in l:
        cnt[0]+=1
        ind=l[:len(l)-len(l.lstrip())]
        res.append('%sVDBG("fail %d\\n");' % (ind, cnt[0]))
    res.append(l)
body='\n'.join(res)
s=s[:start]+body+s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
print(cnt[0])
